verdicts.title: Quantum circuit lower bounds in the magic hierarchy
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We introduce the magic hierarchy, a quantum circuit model that alternates between arbitrary-sized Clifford circuits and constant-depth circuits with two-qubit gates ($\textsf{QNC}^0$). This model unifies existing circuit models, such as $\textsf{QAC}^0_f$ and models with adaptive intermediate measurements. Despite its generality, we are able to prove nontrivial lower bounds.

verdicts.title: Upper bounds on Kronecker coefficients with few rows
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present three different upper bounds for Kronecker coefficients $g(λ,μ,ν)$ in terms of Kostka numbers, contingency tables and Littlewood--Richardson coefficients. We then give various examples, asymptotic applications, and compare them with existing lower bounds.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns upper bounds for Kronecker coefficients in representation theory via Kostka numbers and Littlewood-Richardson coefficients, which has no interaction with golden-ratio rotation discrepancy or ACC^0[m] circuit lower bounds.

verdicts.title: Bounds on Kronecker and $q$-binomial coefficients
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a lower bound on the Kronecker coefficients for tensor squares of the symmetric group via the characters of~$S_n$, which we apply to obtain various explicit estimates. Notably, we extend Sylvester's unimodality of $q$-binomial coefficients $\binom{n}{k}_q$ as polynomials in~$q$ to derive sharp bounds on the differences of their consecutive coefficients. We then derive effective asymptotic lower bounds for a wider class of Kronecker coefficients.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Kronecker coefficients of the symmetric group and q-binomial unimodality, sharing only the word 'Kronecker' (representation theory sense, not Kronecker sequences in equidistribution). It does not address rotation discrepancy, ACC^0[m] circuits, or natural properties.
